notes: SELF-OWNED / bring-your-own exits — Recognition operates no servers. 'tor-local' works if you run Tor (SOCKS 9050). Replace the exit-us/exit-eu hosts with YOUR own WireGuard/SOCKS/HTTP exits (self-hosted or a provider), or add more { name, region, proxy }. Pick one in Settings > Network or the toolbar VPN menu, or Auto-optimize to select the lowest-latency reachable exit. Incognito always routes through the first available endpoint. Routing changes apply on next launch (the engine proxy is set at startup).
